text:
Aleksanteri Kaskimaki has spent the fall proving he belongs in the NHL after five games last season, and the Blues have kept him around for 12. He's a 22-year-old Finnish center, a third-round pick in 2022, who earned the look with 34 points in 63 AHL games at Springfield.

The production is light so far: one goal and three points, on 2.4 expected goals. His shooting will come up. The encouraging sign is the trend in his minutes: he played 16:48 and 16:54 in the wins over Pittsburgh and New Jersey, his two biggest workloads lately.

He took a knock on Nov 14 but was cleared to play three days later, per CBS Sports. At five on five St. Louis is about even in chances with him on, which is what you want from a young depth center. The team has also scored 5.1 more goals than expected with him on, so the on-ice results flatter him a bit.

What to watch: whether the bigger role survives the next healthy body coming back.
